meta.parties: Punchi Appu v. Aralis Appu Et Al

rules.statement: A judgment-creditor who purchases property at an execution sale may challenge earlier fraudulent transfers by the debtor, but should first attempt to have those transfers set aside before buying.
rules.supporting_quote: "The proper course for the plaintiff to have adopted was to have seized and registered his seizure of lot 2. He should have had the first defendant examined under section 219 of the Civil Procedure Code and if he disclosed other property which was not claimed by others the plaintiff should have sold it and he would have then known whether lot 2 was needed to satisfy his claim."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 219 of the Civil Procedure Code
